cutoffMeaning: Explicit or invocation time; not a phase-completion claim
scope: Union of closed run.json/process.json guards, including ExecutionGuard workers and failures. Reused or nested receipts are never double-counted. Open intervals have no invented finish. Uncovered elapsed time is unclassified, not measured waiting or idle time; it includes source and tool work, analysis, review and unobserved work. This is occupancy, not CPU utilization.
